businesses.business: flavored sparkling water and soft drinks

offering_description.value: Develops, manufactures and markets flavored sparkling waters, carbonated soft drinks, juices, energy drinks and other beverages. Sells mainly to grocery, mass merchant, club and convenience retailers, which resell to consumers. Produces at company-operated bottling plants.

primary_products.value: flavored sparkling water; carbonated soft drinks; energy drinks; juices and juice drinks; still and sports drinks

customer_segment.value: B2B: grocery chains, mass merchants, club stores, convenience stores, foodservice and wholesalers

end_markets.value: packaged beverages; grocery retail; convenience retail; foodservice

revenue_model.value: product sales: packaged beverages sold to retailers and distributors

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: buys sweeteners, concentrates, packaging and produces beverages, sold to retailers; brand owner: owns and markets its own beverage brands

geography_served.value: US national: United States, with some sales in Canada and other markets

specialization.value: related lines: sparkling water, soft drinks, juices, energy and sports drinks

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct store delivery and warehouse shipments to grocery, mass and club retailers; distributors / dealers: wholesalers and foodservice distributors

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: food and beverage labeling and safety rules from FDA, environmental and packaging rules
